description: M5 item 6 — transactional installer (validate -> partition -> format -> copy -> verify -> boot config -> sync, with rollback). The in-kernel installer self-test (feature boot-smoke-tests) runs in drivers::init BEFORE auto_mount, in the Live/ISO environment where the installer ESP/BIOS payloads are present, against a BLANK scratch AHCI disk attached by the harness (--scratch-disk / run.scratch_disk_mib). Phase A: a transaction with an injected mid-transaction fault (AfterPartition) must restore the scratch's FRONT (LBA 0..=33) and BACK (LBA blocks-33..=blocks-1) partition-table regions byte-for-byte to their pre-write (blank) state, proving rollback; the disk must have no readable GPT afterwards. Phase B: a clean transaction must run every phase and self-verify — the GPT reads back with the ESP and DUNIT-SYSTEM partitions, the freshly formatted root fscks Clean, and the protective MBR carries the 0x55aa boot signature; the install is left unmounted. The subsequent normal auto_mount then finds and mounts the freshly installed DUNIT-SYSTEM partition at /persist, proving the installed image is real and mountable. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_installer_markers.json --timeout 360 --boot-timeout 320 --post-boot-delay 2 --settle 2

required.claim: the AHCI controller came up so a writable SATA scratch target exists
the installer self-test launched before auto_mount
a blank scratch AHCI disk was selected as the install target
the transaction's rollback path restored both partition-table snapshots after the injected fault
after the fault-injected transaction the scratch's FRONT/BACK regions are byte-identical to the pre-write state and no GPT remains — rollback is real
the clean transaction ran all phases to a commit
the installed disk reads back with ESP + DUNIT-SYSTEM partitions, a Clean fsck, and a bootable MBR signature
the freshly installed DUNIT-SYSTEM partition was then mounted at /persist by the normal auto_mount — the install is real and mountable
the Live system booted to the terminal after all self-tests

forbidden.why: no blank scratch disk was attached — the installer path is unproven
the ESP/BIOS payloads were missing — the installer could not run

forbidden.marker: [INSTALL-TEST] skipped: a volume is already mounted
forbidden.why: a DunitFS volume was already mounted before the test — ran on the wrong boot path
rollback did not restore the partition table after the injected fault
the clean install did not read back consistent
